changeSet.author: system
changeSet.comment: Redesign digital borrow: a digital borrow is per book, not per format. Remove digital_book_id from borrows. Replace the single unique index with two type-aware partial indexes, so a user can hold a PHYSICAL and a DIGITAL borrow for the same book simultaneously.

rollback.sql: DROP INDEX IF EXISTS uk_active_physical_borrow; DROP INDEX IF EXISTS uk_active_digital_borrow;
